facts.fact: Cameroon's PATNUC, under MINPOSTEL, issued an expression-of-interest notice on 12 November 2025 for a consultant to train 100 IT staff of government agencies in cybersecurity and to build an online digital-hygiene awareness platform for their non-IT staff, over 12 months.
facts.system: PATNUC cybersecurity training for government agencies
